dns.cause: The host name did not resolve.
dns.next: Check the host name: Edit the connection.

refused.next: Check the port and the source's firewall.

timeout.cause: The connection did not answer in time.
timeout.next: Check the host, the port and the network path between the worker and the source.

tls.cause: The TLS handshake failed: the server's certificate is not trusted, or the server offers only TLS older than 1.2.
tls.next: Give the connection your CA certificate (Edit), or upgrade the server to TLS 1.2 or newer.

not_allowed.cause: The address is one a task may not reach.
not_allowed.next: Use an address that can be reached from outside the Lakana stack.

root_unavailable.cause: The worker does not have the ingestion root.
root_unavailable.next: Check the root, or ask the operator to give it to the worker.

not_found.cause: The path under the root, or the bucket or container, does not exist.
not_found.next: Check the path, bucket or container: Edit the connection.

credentials.next: Give the secret again: Edit the connection and enter new values.

failed.cause: The check failed in another way, or no worker finished it within 10 minutes.
failed.next: Read the worker's log, then test again.

list.name: Name
list.noneCommand: Add one from the command line:
list.noEnvironment: You may not read the connections of any environment yet. Ask an administrator for READ_ENVIRONMENT on one.
list.noEnvironmentCommand: Then list them from the command line:

testAll.choose: Choose an environment to test all of its connections.
testAll.tested_one: Tested {{count}} connection in {{environment}}: {{ok}} OK, {{failed}} not OK.
testAll.tested_other: Tested {{count}} connections in {{environment}}: {{ok}} OK, {{failed}} not OK.
testAll.stopped_one: Stopped following {{count}} test in {{environment}}; see the rows.
testAll.stopped_other: Stopped following {{count}} tests in {{environment}}; see the rows.

follow.failed: Could not read the test's progress.
follow.stuck: No worker finished this test within 10 minutes; Test again closes it as failed and starts a new one.

page.stale: Tested before the last change; test it again.
page.noWorker: No worker has taken this test yet. Check that a worker is running: docker compose ps worker, or the lakana local terminal.

note.created: Created {{name}}. Test it now to see that a worker can reach it.

delete.title: Delete the connection {{name}} in {{environment}}?
delete.inUse: Remove it from the asset's @asset(connections=[...]) in git and deploy, then delete it.
delete.secret: Its secret {{secret}} stays in the environment, unbound.

runFailure.task: {{asset}} failed reading it; open the task to read why.
